Mamdani received the most public matching funds, at $13.1 million, with Cuomo receiving $8 million, according to the data. Board figures show Mamdani’s campaign was powered by a record number of small-dollar donors: more than 54,000 people who gave an average of $75 each. He also spent the most in the overall mayoral race, at around $16.5 million, while Cuomo was next at $14.2 million. For the general election, where Cuomo ran as an independent, both he and Mamdani each spent more than $10 million, the data shows.
